title: DSP fast walkers

tellings.quote: Probably the fast walkers that the DSP.

plain: "Fast walkers" is a name for unknown objects that streak quickly past Earth in orbit and are picked up by the Defense Support Program, or DSP, a set of US military satellites built to spot missile launches. A guest named Max raises them in passing, saying something was "probably the fast walkers that the DSP" saw. The point would be that military satellites have recorded unexplained objects in space.
